continued.means: exactly one successor, established by evidence

branched.lineage_id: one per successor, recorded as a set
branched.forbids: picking a winner and discarding the rest

merged.means: several predecessors collapse into one successor

unresolved.means: the evidence does not decide - the DEFAULT when evidence is absent

ended.means: no successor, and the absence is itself evidenced

new.means: no predecessor, and the absence is itself evidenced

same_pattern_id.why: pattern_id collides by design; two unrelated occurrences of one pattern share it

same_path.why: a file can hold several occurrences of the same pattern

path_rename.why: a rename relates files, not the occurrences inside them

structural_context.why: an enclosing symbol can hold several occurrences

anchored_content.why: identical content is exactly what cases 3 and 8 exploit

line_drift.why: proximity is not identity; case 8 is proximity without anything else

evidence_rule: No single evidence kind carries a 'continued' on its own.
This is a floor, not the algorithm: which COMBINATIONS suffice is slice 2
step 1 and is deliberately not fixed here.
Evidence is stored in its own field, never folded into the id and never
collapsed into a score that discards which signals fired.
mapping_provenance_rule: A mapping is a statement about two specific runs over two specific revisions.
Recording both is what keeps it falsifiable outside the context that computed
it; 'mapper' is there because two mappers disagreeing about one pair of runs
is a fact worth being able to see.
preregistration_rule: Fixed BEFORE any algorithm exists, so the algorithm cannot select the cases
that flatter it. identity/tests/test_lineage_contract.py holds the matrix to
this list: a case removed or renamed fails the suite rather than disappearing.
